title: 第一百六十一章 火云记事中第一百六十章 火云记事上

“我确信她认出了我！仅仅是对视一眼，她就认出了我。惊奇的是她并没有戳穿我，也许是顾及自己的清白。”
“那一晚我翻来覆去都没睡着，甚至生出了想要逃出宗门的决定。可一想到师父对我有恩，还给我这么多灵药和功法，我的心就过意不去。行得端，坐得正。有错要认，有罚要受，这是爹对我的教诲。可我是真的怕呀！我怕死呀！”
……
“该来的还是来了，第二天师娘就找到了我。我当即给她跪下，不断的求饶，要多卑微，有多卑微。我说只要她肯放过我，从今往后一定唯她是命，她要我怎样，我就怎样……”
“不知怎么的，在她听了这句话后，悬在我头顶上的飞剑收鞘，她头也不回的走。”
……
“半个月后，师父坐化，我闻讯而来。在葬礼上，她哭的撕心裂肺，由我扶着迎接峰主。”
看到这里楚天舒明显感到了不对劲：“坐化？真的是坐化吗？前面两部功法也有些莫名其妙，正道门派里怎么会有魔功？前面那个乾元燃血功意外翻找出来的还可以解释，但他师父传给他的功法，居然能和魔功产生共鸣，这就奇怪了，正道门派怎么会传承魔功呢？”
“等等，两部都是火系的功法……莫非与红莲业火存在什么联系？”楚天舒猜测道。
继续往下看：
“这女人是个妖女！明明白天还哭得这么伤，到半夜就若无其事一般来到我床上求欢！不顾伦理纲常，她爬到我身上来，那唇亲得我欲火焚身，体态妖娆。我想推开她，可修为不足，被他强上了……”
“妖女荒淫无度！但我又不敢反抗，只得与她日日承欢……这段不伦关系持续了很久。我的身躯日渐消瘦，那时我才明白为何师父会早逝，估计就是被那妖女以双修之术，采阳补阴，给活活采死了！”
……
“这天她给我送来了九阳灵芝，鹿妖内丹，让我好生修养。谢天谢地，她总算是放过了我。我问她为什么要这样，不顾伦理纲常和我云雨，她向我吐露了只言片语。说是业火缠身，无可奈何。除了床上双修以外，她待我极好，四下无人之时，待我如亲夫，柔情似水。谁能想到平日里清冷不尘的她，在背地里会是这副模样。”
“我对于她这副模样，没有半点动心，而是与她假意欢爱，很快便取得了她的信任。她将我视为道侣，让我修炼一门邪功，这样她日后便不用再采我阳，二人便可阴阳相合，共同修炼……”
“业火缠身？莫非是异火？”楚天舒终于发现了异火的信息。
“就这样，我与她整整交欢了五年，她以为我乐在其中，其实我早已有了爱慕的心上人。只是迫于她的淫威，没敢倾诉真情。多亏了她的双修功法，我用了不到五年的时间就达到了脉络巅峰，谁能想到一个独灵脉能够修炼到如此地步！”
……
“死了！夏师姐死了！这个妖女杀了她！他早就看出了我与夏师姐情投意合……她怎么敢！她怎么敢！我一定要杀了她！一定！此仇不报，我誓不为人！”

“夏师姐死后，我并未暴露出一丝一毫的愤怒，而是装作若无其事。继续忍耐……想要报仇，首先必须要有足够的实力！实力为尊！实力为尊呐！没有实力，就是待宰的牛羊！任人摆布！”
这段话字迹凌乱，看得出来作者当时的情绪有多愤怒。
“我的瓶颈到了，于是下山历练。出乎意料的是她没有拦着我，任由我离去。我为了提升实力，早日突破瓶颈……于是来到了幽州剑关，这个与天启国交战的前线。虽然死亡风险很大，但是利益也相当大，只要不死，活下去就能捡漏！在某一次大战过后，我正在捡尸，意外救活了一个丹心巅峰强者。为了报答救命之恩，他收我为徒，在他的指教下，我很快就突破了瓶颈……终于突破丹心了！”
“我向他吐露了自己的遭遇，师父答应帮我除掉妖女，可是天启国派出了龙骑军，大肆进攻剑关，师父带伤参战。三日后便阵亡了。”
……
“师父死后，我没有着急回火云宗，而是游历神州，在青州苍龙山脉猎杀灵兽，提升修为。运气好，侥幸抢到了一只三阶崇明鸟的内丹，将我那所剩无几阳气又补了回来。此后我继续游历青州，意外发现有一处遗迹，找到了改变资质的方法，成功让我的修为更上一层楼！”
“我继续闯荡，在青州南部也闯出了一些名声。由于我爱喝酒，尤其是烈酒，经常喝得醉醉醺醺的。所以人们称我为酒老鬼。”
……
“南元城，原本我不打算久留的。可这一天我碰见了一位姑娘……世上怎会有如此相似的一张脸？她长得和夏师姐简直一模一样！像！太像了！多年之后，居然还会有一朵相同的花于此世绽放！”
“柳依青……很活泼的一个姑娘。”
“于是，我与她交好了，以普通人的身份相遇相识相交……春花沐春风，人间四月……那个姑娘也爱上了我。”
……
“依青，等我回来，我必娶你！”
……
“游历在外十余年，我回到了火云宗，因为我消失了很久，所以白凤峰上早已没了我的位置。不过宗门很看重我这位丹心强者，给了我执法长老一位，地位仅次于峰主。那妖女见我回来又主动找我求欢。其实我明白，这么多年过去，又有欲火缠身，她不知养了多少个面首，和猪狗一般，不知廉耻地交配……为了复仇，我假意干柴烈火，与她激情交欢，把她弄得残花败柳……我不但与她交欢，还顺势提出与她结为夫妻。过去的事我不提，她还真以为我是真的爱她。”
“在宗门摸爬打滚这么多年，我唯一学到的就是忍耐与伪装。

"I'm sure she recognized me! Just by looking at each other, she recognized me. Surprisingly, she didn't expose me, maybe because she was concerned about her innocence."
"That night I tossed and turned without falling asleep, and I even made the decision to escape from the sect. But when I thought about Master being so kind to me and giving me so many elixirs and exercises, I couldn't help but feel guilty. Behave properly and sit upright. You have to admit your mistakes and accept the punishment. This is what my father taught me. But I'm really afraid! I'm afraid of death!"
…
"What was supposed to come came anyway, and the mistress found me the next day. I immediately knelt down to her and kept begging for mercy, how humble I must be. I said that as long as she is willing to let me go, her life will be hers from now on, and I will do whatever she wants from me..."
"Somehow, after she heard these words, the flying sword hanging above my head was sheathed, and she left without looking back."
…
"Half a month later, Master passed away, and I came here after hearing the news. At the funeral, she cried heartbrokenly, and I supported her to welcome the Peak Master."
Seeing this, Chu Tianshu obviously felt something was wrong: "Sitting Hua? Is it really Sitting Hua? The first two exercises are also a bit inexplicable. How can there be magic power in the Zhengdao sect? The Qianyuan Blood Burning Technique in front of him can be explained by accident, but the skill passed down to him by his master can actually resonate with the magic power. This is strange. How can the Zhengdao sect inherit the magic power?"
"Wait a minute, both of them are fire-based exercises...could they be related to the Red Lotus Karmic Fire?" Chu Tianshu guessed.

"This woman is a witch! She was so hurt during the day, but she came to my bed to beg for sex in the middle of the night as if nothing had happened! Regardless of ethics, she climbed on top of me, and her lips made me burn with desire, and her body was enchanting. I wanted to push her away, but I was not strong enough, so he raped me..."
"The enchantress was so licentious! But I didn't dare to resist, so I had to have sex with her every day... This unethical relationship lasted for a long time. My body was getting thinner and thinner, and then I understood why the master died young. It was probably because the enchantress used the dual cultivation technique to harvest yang and replenish yin, and he was killed alive!"
…
"That day she sent me Jiuyang Ganoderma and Deer Demon Neidan, so that I could cultivate myself well. Thank God, she finally let me go. I asked her why she was doing this, regardless of ethics and I was confused, and she confided a few words to me . It's said that she has no choice but to treat me very well except in bed. When there is no one around, she treats me like a husband and is as tender as water. Who would have thought that she would be like this behind the scenes. "
"I was not tempted by her appearance at all, but pretended to be in love with her, and soon gained her trust. She regarded me as a Taoist companion, and asked me to practice an evil skill, so that she would no longer have to pick on my yang in the future, and the two of them could combine yin and yang and practice together..."
"Caught in Karmic Fire? Could it be a strange fire?" Chu Tianshu finally discovered the information about the strange fire.
"In this way, I have been having sex with her for five years. She thought I was enjoying it. In fact, I already had a sweetheart that I admired. It was just because of her power that I didn't dare to tell the truth. Thanks to her dual cultivation technique, I reached the pinnacle of my veins in less than five years. Who would have thought that a single spirit vein could cultivate to such an extent!"
…
"Dead! Senior Sister Xia is dead! This witch killed her! He has long seen that Senior Sister Xia and I are in love... How dare she! How dare she! I must kill her! I must! I will not be a human unless I avenge this!"
"After Senior Sister Xia's death, I did not show any trace of anger, but pretended to be nonchalant. Continue to endure... If you want to take revenge, you must first have enough strength! Strength is respected! Strength is respected! Without strength, you are just a sheep to be slaughtered! At the mercy of others!"
The handwriting of this paragraph is messy, and you can see the author's emotions at the time.How angry.
"My bottleneck was reached, so I went down the mountain to practice. To my surprise, she didn't stop me and let me leave. In order to improve my strength, I broke through the bottleneck as soon as possible... so I came to Youzhou Jianguan, the front line of the battle with the Apocalypse Kingdom. Although the risk of death is high, the benefits are also similar. As long as you don't die, you can pick up leaks! After a certain battle, I was picking up corpses and accidentally rescued a strong man with a strong heart. In order to repay his life-saving grace, he accepted me as his disciple. Under his guidance, I quickly broke through the bottleneck... and finally broke through the heart of the heart!"
"I confided my experience to him, and the master promised to help me get rid of the demon girl. However, the Apocalypse Kingdom sent a dragon cavalry army to attack Jianguan. The master was injured and participated in the battle. He died three days later."
…
"After my master died, I did not rush back to the Huoyun Sect. Instead, I traveled to China, hunting spiritual beasts in the Qingzhou Canglong Mountains to improve my cultivation. I was lucky enough to grab the inner elixir of a third-level Chongming bird, which restored my remaining Yang Qi. After that, I continued to travel to Qingzhou, accidentally discovered a ruins, and found a way to change my qualifications, which successfully brought my cultivation to a higher level!"
"I continued to work hard and gained some fame in southern Qingzhou. Because I love drinking, especially hard liquor, I often get drunk. So people call me Jiu Lao Gui."
…
"Nanyuan City, originally I didn't plan to stay for a long time. But this day I met a girl... How could there be such a similar face in the world? She looks exactly like Senior Sister Xia! Like! So similar! Many years later, the same flower will bloom in this world!"
"Liu Yiqing... a very lively girl."
"So, I made friends with her, and we met and got to know each other as ordinary people... Spring flowers bathed in the spring breeze, April in the world... That girl also fell in love with me."
…
"Yiqing, when I come back, I will marry you!"
…
"After traveling for more than ten years, I returned to the Fire Cloud Sect. Because I disappeared for a long time, my position on the White Phoenix Peak has long been gone. However, the sect valued me, a strong man with a loyal heart, and gave me the title of law enforcement elder, second only to the peak master. When the demon girl saw me coming back, she took the initiative to seek sexual favor with me. In fact, I understand that after so many years, I She was obsessed with lust, and she had countless faces, and she mated shamelessly like a pig or a dog... In order to take revenge, I pretended to have sex with her, and made her miserable... Not only did I have sex with her, but I also proposed to marry her. I don't mention the past, but she really thought that I really loved her. "
“After so many years of struggling in the sect, the only thing I have learned is patience and disguise.
